title: "Primary results"

```{r}
#| label: report-context
#| include: false
find_first <- function(paths) {
  hits <- paths[file.exists(paths)]
  if (length(hits)) hits[[1]] else NA_character_
}
load_plan <- function() {
  path <- find_first(c("config/analysis_plan.R", "../config/analysis_plan.R", "../../config/analysis_plan.R"))
  if (is.na(path)) return(NULL)
  env <- new.env(parent = baseenv())
  sys.source(path, envir = env)
  if (exists("analysis_plan", envir = env, inherits = FALSE)) get("analysis_plan", envir = env) else NULL
}
read_optional_table <- function(paths) {
  path <- find_first(paths)
  if (is.na(path)) return(NULL)
  ext <- tolower(tools::file_ext(path))
  if (ext %in% c("tsv", "txt")) read.delim(path, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) else read.csv(path, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
plan <- load_plan()
```


## Result object

```{r}
result_path <- find_first(c(
  "results/metabolomics_results.rds", "../results/metabolomics_results.rds", "../../results/metabolomics_results.rds",
  "results/microbiome_differential_abundance_results.rds", "../results/microbiome_differential_abundance_results.rds", "../../results/microbiome_differential_abundance_results.rds",
  "results/microbiome_diversity_results.rds", "../results/microbiome_diversity_results.rds", "../../results/microbiome_diversity_results.rds"
))
if (is.na(result_path)) {
  cat("Primary result object is pending. Run and validate the domain model scripts before final interpretation.")
} else {
  result_obj <- readRDS(result_path)
  data.frame(component = names(result_obj), class = vapply(result_obj, function(x) paste(class(x), collapse = "/"), character(1)))
}
```

## Primary tables

```{r}
primary_table <- read_optional_table(c(
  "results/primary_results.tsv", "../results/primary_results.tsv", "../../results/primary_results.tsv",
  "results/differential_abundance_results.tsv", "../results/differential_abundance_results.tsv", "../../results/differential_abundance_results.tsv",
  "results/alpha_diversity_results.tsv", "../results/alpha_diversity_results.tsv", "../../results/alpha_diversity_results.tsv"
))
if (is.null(primary_table)) {
  cat("Primary result table is pending.")
} else {
  head(primary_table, 25)
}
```
